rv.q: The play lumbers somewhat in the last third when the conclusion has already been telegraphed, but under Britt Berke's sure-footed direction, Phyl exhibits the dramatic craft and social conscience of other works of the era by George Bernard Shaw, John Galsworthy, and Harley Granville-Barker. cn.t: Critics praise this Mint Theater revival of Hamilton's 1913 feminist comedy for its ahead-of-its-time themes and Lily Ganser's compelling lead performance, though some find it more historically intriguing than dramatically vital.
